# Allowed permissions for MG4 Simple Launcher.
# Any uses-permission in a manifest NOT listed here FAILS the CI.
# Why: this app replaces the home screen. It runs on every boot, sees every installed
# package, and is the first thing the driver touches. Every new permission widens that
# surface and must be reviewed here.
#
# One line = one full permission name. '#' = comment.

# --- App drawer ---
# Required on API 30+ to enumerate launchable apps. Without it the drawer is empty.
android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES

# --- System-info page ---
# Read-only: active connection type and Wi-Fi link speed for the second carousel page.
# Neither permission opens a socket, and neither exposes SSID/BSSID/MAC (never queried).
android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
android.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE

# --- Network / OTA — UNSTABLE flavor only ---
# Declared solely in src/unstable/AndroidManifest.xml. The unstable channel self-updates
# (checks GitHub pre-releases, https + host allowlist + signature check). The stable APK
# has neither this permission nor any updater code, by construction.
android.permission.INTERNET

# --- Deliberately NOT allowed ---
# Installation always remains user-mediated by Android's package installer.
